description: Add another user to a thread by user ID. The thread must not be archived, and the call succeeds without change if the user is already a member. To have the bot join a thread instead, use discord_join_thread; to remove a member, use discord_delete_thread_member. Bot permissions it may need: Send Messages in Threads. Changes Discord data; safe to retry.

channel_id.description: ID of the thread to add the member to

user_id.description: ID of the user to add to the thread

name: discord_add_thread_member
